messages:
Maya (Partnerships): Quick sync 1: StratusCloud x EdgeWorks microwebinar next Wed 10am PT. Need to lock speaker order, demo runtime, and swag handoff plan.
Luke (Events): I can run the stage call at 9:45. Are we doing any pre-recorded clips or fully live?
Maya (Partnerships): Fully live but short. Speakers: Priya (StratusCloud) - marketplace flow, Tomas (EdgeWorks) - hardware microbench (30\t60s), and Sara (our SE) - integration highlights + Qs.
Anika (Marketing): Slide co-brand deck due Mon EOD. Also need final sticker count and a small tabletop card for the hw kit. Shipping/hand-carry decision affects quantities.
ops-bot: Shipping rules: hand-carry allowed up to 3 kits <=10kg each. Anything >15kg must be freighted. EU shipments require CN22/CI. Manifest tool: https://redwood.internal/ops/manifest
Devon (Eng): For Tomas' hw demo: recommend a cached-prefix demo to keep tokens and runtime low. I'll prepare a 45s script and a small dataset. Also want private VLAN for the bench.
Maya (Partnerships): Good call. Action list: 1) Anika finalize slides + swag by Mon EOD; 2) Devon send demo script + VLAN checklist by Tue noon; 3) Luke produce run-of-show and cue deck by Tue 3pm; 4) ops decide hand-carry vs freight by Tue 5pm.
Luke (Events): Draft run-of-show: 9:40 host check, 9:50 partner miccheck, 9:58 countdown, 10:00 intro (1m), 10:01 Priya marketplace (4m), 10:05 Tomas hw microbench (1m), 10:06 Sara integration + live Qs (4m), 10:10 CTA + wrap (1m). Total 10m. Need slide deck with clear cues at 10:05 for hw.
Anika (Marketing): Ordering 75 stickers + 40 one-pagers unless we freight larger boxes. Curious if Tomas needs an EdgeWorks dev kit onsite or remote bench.
Maya (Partnerships): EdgeWorks wants a physical kit for a live microbench. Two options: hand-carry Lina (same-day pickup) or freight (3-4 days). Lina is available but needs passport + pickup info.
ops-bot: If Lina is used, please add courier details to secure manifest channel. Freight ETA estimate: 72-96 hours. Commercial invoice template: https://redwood.internal/ops/cominvoice/1719994321
Devon (Eng): If hand-carry, I'll make a minimal hardware checklist: power brick, short ethernet, pre-flashed image, and VLAN creds. I'll drop the checklist in #eng-infra by EOD.
Anika (Marketing): Leaning to hand-carry to avoid customs hold-ups. I'll confirm Lina by EOD and update sticker counts if needed.
Luke (Events): Mic config: need lav for Tomas and line-in for any device audio. Tomas, do you need USB-A capture or HDMI?
Maya (Partnerships): Tomas said USB-C capture via EdgeWorks dongle. Devon, can you test capture path Wed morning?
Devon (Eng): Yes, will test capture + VLAN at 8:30 on Wed. Will also include a fallback clip (30s) in case live bench hiccups.
Maya (Partnerships): Great. Ops please confirm freight vs Lina by Tue 5pm. Anika slides + swag decision by Mon EOD. Devon checklist by Tue noon. Luke finalize cue deck Tue 3pm.
Anika (Marketing): On it.
Devon (Eng): Will post checklist.
ops-bot: Reminder sent to @Maya @Anika for courier decision.
Maya (Partnerships): Thanks everyone 1: I'll post a condensed checklist in #partners-ops once Lina or freight is confirmed. :white_check_mark:
